items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: I didn't know Jim. I know they had a bass boy playing that drum. Look back at Tom. Tom Oz playing.

ctx.x: I don't remember who was in it then. You remember Lil' Jim used to play bass drum? Who did he play with, man?
I didn't know who Jim played with. I didn't know Jim. I know they had a bass boy playing that drum. Look back at Tom. Tom Oz playing. I didn't know who Jim played with. Yeah, them old days is gone.
Did they have saxophones when you were in the band?
